cross_cutting_findings.finding: The reusable is a separately saved, hash-checked source. The parent paragraph’s exact include reference links it to the cancellation exceptions context. The student alternative requires both pieces and the submitted evidence set includes both. No general Liquid expansion or hidden reusable prose was assumed.

The personal upgrade subtracts the amount already paid from the full new-plan price. Organization seat additions instead prorate the remaining cycle and require upfront credit-card payment. Submitted answers preserve the distinction.
Unassignment and revocation have different access timing; end-of-cycle billing/reduced next-cycle count are separate. The submitted conjunction and rubric preserve the immediate revocation exception.

cross_cutting_findings.topic: Named product variables and rendered-page provenance
cross_cutting_findings.finding: The reference names Copilot Free and GitHub Support are reasonable glosses of the raw variable identifiers. This independent local review did not verify the manifest’s claimed rendered-page cross-check or template outputs. It validates the policy semantics and conditions in the pinned raw files.

The license file repeats some personal upgrade/cancellation facts in its summary/table. These are legitimate additional retrieval candidates; absence from the selected 15 evidence units must remain unjudged, as the manifest states. No false exhaustiveness claim or automatic-negative treatment was found.
